name: apex-round-desktop
description: Apex Round for Windows and macOS: the web app in a desktop window, with system audio capture, an always-on-top answer window, global shortcuts, a tray icon and meeting detection.
author: Apex Round

scripts.dist: npm run build && node dist/checkConfig.js && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node dist/checkConfig.js && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.release:win: npm run build && node dist/checkConfig.js && electron-builder --win --publish always
scripts.release:mac: npm run build && node dist/checkConfig.js && electron-builder --mac --publish always
